dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, Nam, have you checked your budget?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, hæv juː ˈtʃɛkt jʊr ˈbʌdʒɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. With another thousand baht, the rent would be outside my price range. Would you consider raising it by 500 instead?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wɪð əˈnʌðər ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt, ðə ˈrɛnt wʊd bi ˌaʊtˈsaɪd maɪ ˈpraɪs ˌreɪndʒ. wʊd juː kənˈsɪdər ˈreɪzɪŋ ɪt baɪ ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ɪnˈstɛd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Five hundred? Hmm. Prices are going up everywhere.
dialogue.reading: ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd? ˈhm. ˈpraɪsɪz ər ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈʌp ˈɛvriwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I understand. How about if I fix small things in the apartment myself?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ɪf aɪ ˈfɪks ˈsmɔːl ˈθɪŋz ɪn ði əˈpɑːrtmənt maɪˈsɛlf?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That would help a little. I'm willing to go down to 800.
dialogue.reading: ðæt wʊd ˈhɛlp ə ˈlɪtəl. aɪm ˈwɪlɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ ˈdaʊn tə ˈeɪt ˈhʌndrəd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Could we meet halfway? How about 650?
dialogue.reading: kʊd wiː ˈmiːt ˌhæfˈweɪ? ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ˈsɪks ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! You're good at haggling. Seven hundred is my final offer.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! jʊr ˈɡʊd ət ˈhæɡəlɪŋ. ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd ɪz maɪ ˈfaɪnəl ˈɔːfər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Would you consider including the Wi-Fi in the rent? Then 700 is fine.
dialogue.reading: wʊd juː kənˈsɪdər ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ɪn ðə ˈrɛnt? ˈðɛn ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd ɪz ˈfaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The Wi-Fi? OK, I'm willing to do that.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ? oʊˈkeɪ, aɪm ˈwɪlɪŋ tə ˈduː ˈðæt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. Thank you for being so flexible.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈbiːɪŋ soʊ ˈflɛksəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You always pay on time. I don't want to lose you.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈpeɪ ɑːn ˈtaɪm. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt tə ˈluːz juː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And I don't want to move! I'm happy we found a price that works for both of us.
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmuːv! aɪm ˈhæpi wiː ˈfaʊnd ə ˈpraɪs ðæt ˈwɜːrks fər ˈboʊθ əv ʌs.
